question: A car starts from rest and reaches a speed of 72 km/hr in 20 seconds. What is the acceleration of the car?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 m/s²**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Acceleration is defined as the **rate of change of velocity**.
 
• The formula for acceleration is: **a = (v − u)/t**
 
• Given:
 
 
• Initial velocity, **u = 0 m/s** (car starts from rest)
 
• Final velocity, **v = 72 km/h = 20 m/s** (since 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s)
 
• Time, **t = 20 s**
 
 
 
• Substituting the values:

 **a = (20 − 0)/20 = 1 m/s²**
 
• ***Hence, the acceleration of the car is 1 m/s².***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SI Unit of Acceleration:**

 
 
• Metre per second squared (**m/s²**).
 
 
 
• **Conversion of Speed:**
 
 
• **1 km/h = 5/18 m/s**.
 
• To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by **5/18**.
 
 
 
• **Types of Motion:**
 
 
• If acceleration is constant, the motion is called **uniformly accelerated motion**.
